verdict.rationale: Pipedrive's workflow automation page explicitly claims 'automatic lead assignment' alongside triggered flows. This is the product's own capability for routing leads. The evidence is a single marketing-level mention, with no documentation of how assignment rules or round-robin distribution are configured. Missing for 10: documented assignment-rule configuration, explicit round-robin distribution, owner-matching criteria, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops user, I can route new leads to the right owner automatically with assignment rules or round-robin

citations.quote: Lead scoring automation, automatic lead assignment and revenue forecasting? Check.
Set up flows and triggered events so that tasks happen without you having to lift a finger.
